role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
hero_summary_zh: 克林克兹无形地穿梭在战场上，没人能逃过他的伏击。他的步伐和箭矢迅疾异常，只要召唤出一队炽烈同胞助阵，灼热的箭雨过后就是敌人的死亡。
hero_summary_en: When Clinkz stalks invisibly through the battlefield, none are safe from ambush. Swift of foot and arrow, he rains fiery death upon his foes, calling upon an army of blazing compatriots to bolster his assault.

abilities.name: clinkz_strafe
abilities.description_zh: 克林克兹获得攻击速度和攻击距离加成。克林克兹%strafe_skeleton_radius%范围内现有的骷髅弓手也会获得攻击距离加成和%archer_attack_speed_pct%%%攻击速度加成。施放扫射不会脱离骨隐步的隐身状态。
abilities.description_en: Clinkz gains attack speed and has bonus attack range. Any current Skeleton Archers within a %strafe_skeleton_radius% radius of Clinkz also gain bonus attack range and %archer_attack_speed_pct%%% of the attack speed bonus.  Casting Strafe does not break Skeleton Walk invisibility.
facet_text_en: Clinkz and each Skeleton Archer apply a stacking debuff, one stack per attacking Skeleton Archer, causing them to miss %bonus_blind_pct%%% of their attacks per stack for %debuff_duration%s. Applies to buildings as well.
facet_text_zh: 克林克兹和每个骷髅弓手都会施加一个可叠加的负面效果，每个攻击的骷髅弓手会施加一层叠加效果，每层会使目标的%bonus_blind_pct%%%攻击落空，持续%debuff_duration%秒。也会对建筑施加。

abilities.name: clinkz_searing_arrows
abilities.description_zh: 让克林克兹的箭矢带有火焰，造成更多伤害。骷髅弓手在攻击克林克兹的攻击目标时会发射灼热之箭，造成%skeleton_damage_pct%%%伤害。
abilities.description_en: Imbues Clinkz's arrows with fire for extra damage.Skeleton Archers will fire Searing Arrows at targets Clinkz attacks for %skeleton_damage_pct%%% damage.
notes_zh: 灼热之箭能对建筑造成伤害。
伤害直接作为物理伤害加到克林克兹的攻击伤害中。
notes_en: Searing Arrows deal damage to structures.
The damage is directly added to Clinkz' attack damage, as physical damage.

abilities.name: clinkz_death_pact
abilities.description_zh: 克林克兹以敌方非英雄单位或友方骷髅弓手为吞噬的目标，治疗并获得最大生命值。不会使克林克兹脱离骨隐步。
abilities.description_en: Clinkz consumes the target enemy creep or friendly Skeleton Archer, healing and gaining max health. Does not take Clinkz out of Skeleton Walk.
notes_zh: 如果目标是敌方单位，克林克兹将获得经验和金钱。
克林克兹的当前血量和生命值上限都将提高。
持续时间结束后，血量上限回到正常值，但是当前生命值不变（不会高于血量上限）。
notes_en: If the target is an enemy, Clinkz will gain the correct experience and gold.
Increases Clinkz' current and max HP.
When the duration ends, max HP returns to normal, but current HP stays the same.
facet_text_en: Death Pact teleports Clinkz towards his victim. Reduces Death Pact cooldown. If Alt-Cast behavior is activated, or Clinkz is Rooted or Leashed, he will not teleport to the target location.
facet_text_zh: 死亡契约会把克林克兹传送至目标。降低死亡契约的充能时间。如果设为<font color="#FF0000">多样施法</font>（右键点击技能栏图标），或者克林克兹被缠绕或束缚，那他就不会传送至目标地点。

abilities.name: clinkz_burning_barrage
abilities.description_zh: 持续施法 - 克林克兹持续施法，朝目标方向射出多支灼热的箭矢，击中所有敌人，造成克林克兹攻击伤害的一定百分比并施加攻击特效。
abilities.description_en: CHANNELED - Clinkz channels and shoots multiple piercing arrows in the target direction that hit all enemy units dealing a percentage of Clinkz' attack damage and applying attack modifiers.
notes_zh: 攻击距离加成会提升炽烈火雨的长度。
notes_en: Bonus Attack Range increases the length of Burning Barrage.

abilities.name: clinkz_burning_army
abilities.description_zh: 在目标地点召唤一列烈焰骷髅弓手。
abilities.description_en: Summons a row of Burning Skeleton Archers in the target location.

abilities.name: clinkz_wind_walk
abilities.description_zh: 克林克兹进入隐身状态，移动可以穿过其他单位，攻击或使用物品时现形。脱离隐身后会产生骷髅弓手。骷髅弓手不能移动，需要多次英雄或防御塔攻击才会被击杀。骷髅弓手继承克林克兹一定百分比的攻击力，对建筑造成的伤害降低%skeleton_building_damage_reduction%%%。攻击距离与克林克兹相同。
abilities.description_en: Clinkz moves invisibly through units until the moment he attacks or uses items. Leaving Skeleton Walk creates Skeleton Archers.Skeleton Archers are immobile and die within multiple attacks from a hero or tower. Skeleton Archers deal a percentage of Clinkz' damage, and deal %skeleton_building_damage_reduction%%% less damage to buildings. Attack range is equal to Clinkz' attack range.

abilities.name: clinkz_infernal_shred
abilities.description_zh: 克林克兹和他的骷髅弓手会施加一个可叠加的负面效果，使他们的攻击可以穿透最高目标%max_armor_piercing_pct%%%总物理护甲（不会降低他们的护甲）。克林克兹每次攻击施加%hero_stacks%%%，骷髅弓手施加%skeleton_stacks%%%。持续%duration%秒。
abilities.description_en: Clinkz and his skeletons apply a stacking debuff that causes their attacks to pierce up to %max_armor_piercing_pct%%% of the target's total physical armor (does not reduce their armor).  Clinkz applies %hero_stacks%%% per attack, and skeletons apply %skeleton_stacks%%%. Lasts %duration% seconds.

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_clinkz_3
talents_raw.desc_loc: A Searing Arrows attack will send another arrow into a random enemy within Clinkz's attack range.
